overview: Echo stands among the saga's most memorable figures, known throughout the galaxy as a clone commando. An ARC trooper believed dead on Lola Sayu who was rescued from Separatist captivity and joined the Bad Batch. From backwater cantinas to senate chambers and fleet command centers, Echo's story illustrates how individuals outside the Jedi and Sith orders can still move history.
